texts.Feature:VaultIndex.Enable:Description: Lets the tenant use Vault Index's application services: search and index management.
texts.VaultIndex:EmptyDocument: The document has no text to index.
texts.VaultIndex:DocumentTooLarge: The document's text has {Length} characters, more than the {MaxLength} the index accepts.
texts.VaultIndex:TooManyChunks: The document splits into {Count} chunks, more than the {Max} the index accepts.
texts.VaultIndex:EmbeddingGeneratorMissing: No embedding model is configured for Vault Index.
texts.VaultIndex:EmbeddingModelChanged: The configured embedding model {ModelId} ({Dimensions} dimensions) is not the one the index was built with, {ServingModelId} ({ServingDimensions} dimensions). Rebuild the index for the new model.
texts.VaultIndex:EmbeddingDimensionMismatch: The embedding model returned {Dimensions}-dimension vectors; the index storage holds {StorageDimensions}.
texts.VaultIndex:UnsupportedReadScope: Extract returned a read scope of version {Version}, which this version of Vault Index does not support.
texts.VaultIndex:InvalidPointer: '{Pointer}' is not a pointer returned by search or outline.
texts.IndexStatus:ExactSearchLimitExceeded: Over {0} chunks: vector search is exact and slows down past this size.
texts.IndexStatus:NoModelConfigured: No embedding model is configured, so nothing is indexed.
texts.IndexStatus:ModelMismatch: The configured model is not the one the index was built with, so search is refused until the index is rebuilt.
texts.IndexStatus:KeywordIndexUnavailable: Full-Text Search is not installed: search uses vectors only.
texts.IndexStatus:Title: Title
texts.IndexStatus:RebuildConfirm: Index this document again from its current text, even if nothing changed?
